g.ns0:title: 1758 · static closed steel armour display, spear and oblique shield
g.ns0:desc: Hand-redrawn native SVG at 68 by 195; quiet aged black steel and silver-grey planes; original empty-helmet display stance.

g.ns0:title: CF6 1743 R2: recomposed Dutch floral detail in editable carved frame
g.ns0:desc: Reference-informed hybrid reconstruction of CF6 picture 1743: original 72×89 registration and unchanged editable R1 carved frame; unique high-resolution flower/leaf details from the public-domain NGA reproduction of Jan Davidsz de Heem, Vase of Flowers (c. 1660), individually cropped, masked and rearranged to the game reference. Newly authored SVG dark ground and connective stems; the blue-gray vase is newly modeled with broad glaze gradients and small brush marks, while the table includes a color-adapted historical stone-surface crop. Edge integration uses luminance mattes without blur; original crop RGB remains unchanged. This does not identify the game image as this historical painting, and is not wholly hand-drawn vector art.
